verdict.rationale: Apify provides a documented webhooks system that triggers HTTP requests to external services on platform events (e.g., actor run finished/failed), enabling event-driven subscriptions suitable for AI-native/agentic workflows. This is first-party, well-documented core platform functionality. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of webhook reliability and no explicit mention of webhook use specifically in agentic/AI-triggered contexts beyond general docs.
